done_summary: Implemented context isolation per request during async SSR and fixed ErrorBoundary fallback rendering. Context values are now held in a per-render store carried across await boundaries with AsyncLocalStorage when available; otherwise, post-await reads fall back to the context default value. Every async suspension point captures and re-establishes the store. ErrorBoundary now sets a 'caught' flag on the first catch so the fallback renders and reports exactly once. Suspense pops its build-data stack on a rejected re-render.
